recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future concerns about individual string or markdown fields should be handled as field-specific Jira issues rather than by globally converting free-form fields to markdown.
issue_request: FHIR-20598 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for an STU3 question about when free-form fields should use string versus markdown, citing HealthcareService.comment as string while HealthcareService.eligibility.comment was markdown. The resolution added design guidance, acknowledged subjective per-element choices, and invited specific trackers for fields believed to use the wrong datatype.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-20598 was found. Current source/datatypes.html contains markdown datatype guidance and current source/healthcareservice/structuredefinition-HealthcareService.xml has both HealthcareService.comment and HealthcareService.eligibility.comment as markdown. Git history shows the HealthcareService.comment change was made by FHIR-39575.
additional_context: MnM minutes corroborate the 2019-09-03 Persuasive with Modification vote. The historical HL7 wiki guidance says string is for simple text where formatting is unnecessary, inappropriate, or rarely supported, and markdown is for multiple paragraphs or formatting. Later published issues FHIR-38714 and FHIR-40555 refined the official markdown datatype and string-to-markdown safety guidance, while FHIR-40560 shows markdown changes still require element-specific judgment.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was made because the current spec already contains the relevant markdown guidance and the concrete HealthcareService example has been resolved through the separate field-specific path recommended by the seed issue.
